In the context of a hypothetical, write the jacket blurb for a thriller where a modern day operative of the FBI, ends up back in the early 1960's having to use her knowledge of "future" forensics to leave clues to enable her modern colleagues to catch a time-hopping serial-killer, before he dies.assistant
response:
"When FBI operative Rachel Jenkins is sent back in time to the early 1960s, she finds herself in the midst of a decades-old mystery. A serial killer, known only as 'The Timekeeper,' has been terrorizing the nation, leaving a trail of bodies in his wake. But this is no ordinary killer - he's a time-hopper, able to move through the ages with ease.

As Rachel navigates the unfamiliar streets of 1960s America, she must use her knowledge of future forensics to leave clues that will aid her modern colleagues in catching The Timekeeper. But with each passing day, she realizes that she's not the only one who knows the killer's true identity.

With the help of a local detective, Jack, Rachel must unravel the threads of a decades-old conspiracy that goes all the way to the top. But as they get closer to the truth, they realize that The Timekeeper is not just a killer - he's a master of time itself.

As the body count rises, Rachel and Jack must work together to prevent The Timekeeper from striking again. But with the clock ticking down, they know they're running out of time. Can they catch The Timekeeper before he strikes again, or will he continue to leave a trail of bodies in his wake?

The clock is ticking, and the stakes are higher than ever. Will Rachel and Jack be able to solve the mystery of The Timekeeper before it's too late? Or will they become the next victims of this time-hopping serial killer?

13 days, 12 hours, and 45 minutes remain until The Timekeeper strikes again. The fate of the world hangs in the balance. Can Rachel and Jack stop him before it's too late?"
